envelope.description: Run serial bounded continuations with retry and cancellation

body.title: Run serial bounded continuations with retry and cancellation
body.summary: Implement continuation.ts to seed navigation-oriented requests, run qualified backend through its bound LLMProvider, expose narrow source/impact/progress tools and return validated replies referencing accepted block receipts.
acceptanceChecks: One compatible backend session can inspect related obligations and ACK several blocks; no mandatory call per clause/block or eager whole-source packet.
Serialize provider work; enforce accepted-progress barrier before next block assessment and preserve earlier accepted receipts on enclosing-call failure.

At most one immediate transient retry with new attempt identity and retained consumption, provider internalRetry:false; non-transient binding/schema/permission/budget/stale failures do not auto-retry.
Abort provider/tools promptly, fence late callbacks and pause before pending backlog; final reply cannot silently reapply accepted deltas or publish a verdict.
Focused grouped-session, block-yield, unsupported-backend, retry/cancel/deadline and final-reply tests pass.

tests.name: Grouped continuation execution, bounded retries and cancellation
